description: Figure 1, located on the right side of the page, is a line plot that compares the loss of a vanilla Transformer model against the proposed SepLLM framework. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs," represents the computational cost and is scaled linearly, ranging from 0.00 to 1.25 with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. The y-axis, labeled "Loss," is also scaled linearly, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The plot displays two lines: a purple line representing the "Vanilla" model and a red line representing "SepLLM." Both lines show a decreasing trend, indicating that loss decreases as computational cost increases. The "Vanilla" model starts at a loss of approximately 2.72 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreases to about 2.50 at 1.25 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM" model starts at a loss of approximately 2.68 at 0.00 TFLOPs and decreases to about 2.48 at 1.25 TFLOPs. The "SepLLM" line is consistently below the "Vanilla" line across the entire range of TFLOPs, indicating that SepLLM achieves a lower loss for any given computational cost. A green dashed line at a loss of 2.50 is shown, and a green box highlights the point where the "SepLLM" line reaches this value, with a label indicating a 1.28x improvement.
